items.event_title: China investigates Meituan and Alibaba units for suspected antitrust violations
items.news_summary: Chinese regulators opened investigations into units tied to Meituan and Alibaba over suspected unfair-competition violations in online travel/hotel platforms.
items.investor_materiality: Renewed platform regulation can affect take rates, competitive behavior and valuation of major Chinese internet names including U.S.-listed Alibaba.
items.selection_reason: Fresh Reuters-confirmed regulatory catalyst involving large internet platforms.
items.source_quality_note: Reuters citing regulator/CCTV and company cooperation statements.

items.event_title: Oracle's $18 billion data-center debt comes under pressure
items.news_summary: Reuters, citing the FT, reports $18 billion of loans tied to Oracle's Project Jupiter AI data center are trading below par amid project, environmental and leverage concerns.
items.investor_materiality: Direct read-through to the financing cost and balance-sheet risk of hyperscale AI infrastructure buildout.
items.selection_reason: Large-dollar AI infrastructure financing stress at a major U.S. cloud/software company.
items.source_quality_note: Reuters report based on FT reporting; Oracle and lenders declined comment.

items.event_title: US and China discuss cutting tariffs on U.S. LNG ahead of Xi visit
items.news_summary: U.S. and Chinese officials are discussing reducing or eliminating Chinese tariffs on U.S. LNG as part of a broader energy package.
items.investor_materiality: Could materially affect U.S. LNG exporters, gas demand, shipping and the wider U.S.-China trade relationship.
items.selection_reason: Reuters-confirmed policy negotiation with direct energy-equity consequences.
items.source_quality_note: Reuters; discussions are not a final agreement.

items.event_title: FedEx-Advent consortium secures 89.81% of InPost shares in takeover offer
items.news_summary: The FedEx/Advent-led consortium exceeded the 80% acceptance threshold in its roughly €7.8 billion all-cash InPost takeover.
items.investor_materiality: Meaningful strategic expansion into European parcel lockers and last-mile logistics for FedEx.
items.selection_reason: Concrete M&A milestone with Reuters confirmation and a clear logistics strategy angle.
items.source_quality_note: Reuters with tender results and transaction terms.

items.event_title: 10-year Treasury yield around 5% keeps pressure on equities as oil remains elevated
items.news_summary: U.S. benchmark yields remained around the 5% area after a volatile week, while energy costs continued to complicate the inflation and growth outlook.
items.investor_materiality: A 5% benchmark yield directly raises discount rates and financing costs, particularly for long-duration technology equities.
items.selection_reason: Central cross-asset driver for U.S. stock valuations and macro positioning.
items.source_quality_note: Reuters macro analysis; use live Treasury/oil data for exact current levels.

items.event_title: European AI firms push back against U.S. calls to slow frontier AI development
items.news_summary: Reuters reports European AI companies and officials are resisting safety-driven slowdown proposals associated with U.S. frontier labs, arguing they could entrench American dominance.
items.investor_materiality: Highlights regulatory competition, AI sovereignty and the competitive position of U.S. frontier labs versus European challengers.
items.selection_reason: Fresh policy/competition angle with direct implications for OpenAI, Anthropic and European AI capital allocation.
items.source_quality_note: Reuters reporting across companies, officials and academics.

items.news_summary: ECB President Christine Lagarde signaled a measured policy approach despite energy-driven inflation and market pricing for multiple additional hikes.
items.investor_materiality: Changes the expected European rate path, euro, bond yields and global financial conditions.
items.selection_reason: Fresh central-bank guidance amid a global energy and bond-market shock.
items.source_quality_note: Direct Reuters coverage of Lagarde comments.

items.event_title: EU officials call for larger banks and deeper capital markets to compete with U.S. peers
items.news_summary: Senior EU officials urged fewer barriers to cross-border bank mergers and deeper capital markets, noting U.S. banks' scale and technology spending advantages.
items.investor_materiality: Potentially relevant to European bank consolidation, capital-market reform and transatlantic financial competition.

items.event_title: PBOC adviser warns AI could deepen China's supply-demand imbalance
items.news_summary: PBOC monetary policy committee member Huang Yiping warned that AI-led production gains could worsen China's strong-supply/weak-demand imbalance without stronger consumption and balance-sheet repair.
items.investor_materiality: Important macro framing for Chinese technology, industrial overcapacity, exports and policy stimulus expectations.
items.selection_reason: Fresh high-level policy commentary linking AI investment to China's core macro imbalance.
items.source_quality_note: Reuters reporting comments by a PBOC monetary policy committee member.
